text:
sara: AZ-EU2 (eu-west-2) — multiple Private clusters reporting model decryption failures, HSM connections timing out. Seeing 502s from kms-proxy. Anyone else?

mike: seeing alerts from health-checker. Lots of "decrypt failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable" in logs. Nodes that host kms-agent endpoints losing heartbeats intermittently.

leo: confirmed: host-level networking flaps to Azure HSM IPs starting ~1758004000. Also noticed controller removed a few GPU nodes for failing liveness probes.

karen: impact: Private deployments in AZ-EU2 can't load model keys -> requests failing fast. Hosted API unaffected. Dedicated capacity partially impacted where Private traffic was routed to same region.

infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-4219 assigned to infra-oncall. Pager escalation to mike. Support ticket opened with Azure: 1723456789.

mike: I'm on it. First step: isolate whether this is cloud-side firewall or HSM-managed network. @leo can you run quick packet check on one of the affected nodes?

leo: running tcpdump now on node private-gpu-12: ```sudo tcpdump -n host 13.92.45.120 and port 7443 -c 200``` saw repeated TCP retransmits and RSTs. Azure side acknowledged they have a fabric event in the availability zone.

sara: ok — immediate mitigation options: 1) Failover Private traffic for affected customers to our hosted-managed key path (requires sec sign-off), 2) Shift traffic to EU-North (eu-west-1) or Dedicated pools in other regions, 3) Apply local ephemeral key wrapping (complex). Thoughts?

anya: Security: falling back to hosted-managed keys is acceptable temporarily for impacted customers if we record audit logs and notify customers. Need explicit list of projects and start/stop times. No key material should be exported. :warning:

mike: agree. Let's preferentially shift traffic to other eu regions first to avoid key policy changes. But we need capacity. Leo, can we spin up extra Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 and eu-central? Estimate how many GPUs to take load.

leo: current queue shows ~120 qps of Private decrypt traffic. Each A100 in Dedicated handles ~220 qps peak after batching. So spinning 1-2 nodes (8xA100 equiv) should cover. Provisioning time ~12-18 mins for reserved images in those regions.

karen: note: some customers have geo-locks—can't move keys across region. Those will need hosted-managed fallback. I'll compile list now.

sara: mike, start cross-region routing policy to send new connections for AZ-EU2 to eu-west-1 where capacity will be added. Use smart routing override with tag: region-fallback-az-eu2. Also create canary traffic at 5%.

mike: doing. Command: ```curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/overrides -d '{"source_region":"eu-west-2","target_region":"eu-west-1","percent":5,"tag":"region-fallback-az-eu2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'```

mike: pushed 5% canary. Monitoring latency/errors. No regressions yet. Increasing to 25% in 5m if stable.

leo: infra autoproc started spin-up: 2 nodes queued in eu-west-1 (pool: dedicated-eu-west-1-gpu). ETA ~10m.

anya: while this happens: please prepare customer comms for those moved to hosted-managed keys. Must include duration, why, and that keys remain encrypted under our KM. I'll draft.

karen: here is list of 7 customers with region-locked keys (IDs): cust-112, cust-309, cust-451, cust-772, cust-901, cust-912, cust-998. These will be routed to hosted-managed KMS unless they opt out.

sara: @anya, approve fallback for those 7? We'll log actions and set TTL for fallback at 6 hours with auto-revert.

anya: approved for emergency use only. Ensure customer opt-out flag is respected. I'll audit logs and join postmortem.

mike: implemented hosted-managed fallback for the 7 customers: ```PATCH /private/v1/customers/{id}/kms -d '{"fallback":"hosted-managed","ttl":"6h","reason":"AZ-EU2 HSM outage"}'``` response 200 for all.

infra-bot: Azure support update: "Fabric event affecting HSM connectivity in eu-west-2. Mitigation in progress. ETA 45-90 mins to full fabric restoration." Ticket: 1723456789.

leo: after routing changes and spinning new Dedicated nodes, error rate for decrypt failures dropped from 18% -> 2%. Latency for affected requests increased ~30ms due to cross-region, but within SLO for most customers.

mike: increasing routing to 50% then 100% as capacity stabilizes. Monitoring critical dashboards and token-level cost. Heads-up: this will increase cross-region egress costs.

sara: noted on costs. We'll attach a cost memo to the incident. For now keep operating. Also open action: add automated region-fallback playbook and pre-warm cross-region Dedicated capacity for AZ-EU2 in future.

karen: recording timeline and runbook steps. Will follow up with postmortem, including Azure ticket details and what we asked them to change.

anya: confirm: no key exports, hosted-managed path used only for encryption/decryption at rest, audit trail in place. Fine.

mike: Azure pushed a partial fix at 1758007000 — HSM connections stable. Rolling back overrides to default in 20m to test.

leo: performing health sweep and will drain the temporary nodes once traffic normalizes. Command used to drain: ```kubectl -n dedicated scale deployment/gpu-pool-temp --replicas=0```

sara: great work everyone. After rollback we'll run a short soak test and then close incident. Postmortem owners: karen (ops), anya (sec), leo (infra).

infra-bot: Incident resolved: root cause: Azure fabric event disrupting connectivity to HSM endpoints in eu-west-2. Mitigation: cross-region routing + hosted-managed fallback for region-locked customers. Azure ETA matched. Ticket 1723456789.

mike: closing thread but keeping postmortem thread live. Thanks all. :clap:
